title: Bloomburrow | Episode 3: The Lost and the Found

entities.name: Helga
entities.description: A frogfolk whose drawings show visions of the Calamity Beasts and Jace; she creates water steps in the fight and urges following the necromancers.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: A mousefolk leader of the party who wields a fang-sword and shield and chooses to follow Cruelclaw's trail.

entities.name: Finneas
entities.description: A rabbitfolk farmer and archer on his first trip beyond Goodhill, who uses vine-sack arrows.

entities.name: Hugs
entities.description: A strong badgerfolk who carries Zoraline and keeps everyone afloat in the river.

entities.name: Gev
entities.description: A lizardfolk fire-mace fighter who tells tall tales of the Striped Rapscallions.

entities.name: Zoraline
entities.description: A dark-furred batfolk cleric who sleeps by day and drains necromancers' magic.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who has become an otterfolk, searching for Jace Beleren in Three Tree City, and who joins the party.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker Ral is hunting, seen in Helga's visions as a foxfolk in a blue cloak with a lizardfolk and a small creature.

entities.name: Cruelclaw
entities.description: A figure whose job the squirrelfolk necromancers are carrying out.

entities.name: Squirrelfolk necromancers
entities.description: Two black-clad squirrelfolk necromancers searching Pondside's rubble who summon skeletons and flee toward the Long River.

entities.name: Kiki
entities.description: A skunkfolk who traveled with Hugs and Gev and retired to raise ladybugs.

entities.name: Maha, the Night Owl
entities.description: The Calamity Beast that wrecked Pondside.

entities.name: The Flood Gar
entities.description: A Calamity Beast, an enormous silver fish with glowing markings that floods the Docklands.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Fearsome natural disaster creatures.

entities.name: Oliver
entities.description: The mayor of Goodhill who gives a speech at their departure.

entities.name: King Glarb
entities.description: The weaver who sent Helga away after a mistake.

entities.name: Granfer and Granmer
entities.description: Helga's grandparents who encouraged her.

entities.name: Pondside
entities.description: The ruined village, whose villagers fled south toward Haymeadow.

entities.name: Three Tree City
entities.description: A city built in an oak, sycamore and willow along the Long River, with the Docklands and Quilted District.

entities.name: Docklands
entities.description: The wharves and rafts of Three Tree City beneath the willow, which the Flood Gar attacks.

entities.name: Long River
entities.description: The river that carries the party past Three Tree City.

entities.name: Haymeadow
entities.description: A village south of Pondside where villagers likely fled.

entities.name: Calamity Graveyard
entities.description: A place Gev claims to have visited.

entities.name: Goodhill
entities.description: Mabel's home town.

entities.name: The marshy cave
entities.description: A cave downriver where the party washes ashore and is surrounded by ratfolk.

entities.name: Ratfolk
entities.description: Hooded ratfolk who threaten the party in the marshy cave.

entities.name: The fang-sword
entities.description: Mabel's flame-edged ancestral sword.

events.summary: The party departs Goodhill for Pondside amid fanfare.
On the road Gev tells a tall tale of the Striped Rapscallions, which Mabel says is his way of coping.
events.quote: the stories are Gev's way of coping.

events.summary: The party reaches the ruins of Pondside and Hugs and Mabel read tracks showing the villagers went south toward Haymeadow.
events.quote: Haymeadow, likely. It's closer than Goodhill.

events.summary: Two squirrelfolk necromancers are found looting the wreckage and mention Cruelclaw and the owl's earlier attack.
events.quote: Helga's skin crawled. The last one? So, her dream-vision was true?

events.summary: The necromancers raise skeletons and the party fights them.
events.quote: dozens of gleaming eyes surrounded the Goodhill delegation.

events.summary: Helga makes water steps so Mabel can reach the birds, but loses control of the spell; Mabel still kills the skeleton.
events.quote: With a sound like a bubble popping, the stairs fell to splatter the soil.

events.summary: The necromancers flee toward the Long River, and the party decides to follow them to Three Tree City.
events.quote: "We follow the squirrelfolk," she said. "To Three Tree."

events.summary: Helga packs keepsakes from her grandparents' damaged home before leaving.
events.quote: Why did she take her grandfather's wand, set his wide-brimmed hat on her own head?

events.summary: Otterfolk carry the party by boat to Three Tree City's Docklands.
events.quote: They arrived at the Docklands beneath the drooping tendrils of the willow

events.summary: Mabel meets Ral Zarek, an otterfolk hunting Jace Beleren, who grabs Helga after seeing her drawing.
events.quote: "Ral," he replied. "Ral Zarek. I'm looking for someone named Jace Beleren."

events.summary: Helga describes her vision of Jace with a green and black lizardfolk and a hard-to-see creature, and Ral decides to keep her in sight.
events.quote: Right now, you're my only link to Beleren, so I'm not letting you out of my sight.

events.summary: The river surges and the Flood Gar, a Calamity Beast, attacks the Docklands.
A great wave sweeps the party into the Long River where Hugs keeps everyone afloat.
events.quote: Mabel sucked in a deep breath and clung to Hugs

events.summary: The current slows and the party washes ashore in a marshy cave, where hooded ratfolk surround them and tell them to leave.
events.quote: "Outsiders," a ratfolk hissed. "You are not welcome here.

relations.note: Hugs and Gev traveled together as the Striped Rapscallions.
Zoraline rides sleeping on Hugs's back.
relations.quote: Hugs, the badgerfolk with handsome white stripes, lumbered along with Zoraline hanging upside down from his back.

relations.note: The Calamity Beast floods the Docklands.
relations.quote: The river had risen well past the high tide marker on a nearby piling and continued to swell

relations.note: The squirrelfolk are doing a job for Cruelclaw.
relations.quote: Why is Cruelclaw wasting our time with rubble combing?

relations.note: Mabel gently forgives Helga's failed spell.
